precepts.text: Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country; and I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people. So that's only the Israelites. And verse 1: I was jealous for Zion. Zion is not all nations on the planet. The ones coming from the east country and the west country to sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob is Zion.
precepts.point: Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven. So let's find out who's coming from the east and west.
precepts.why:
A Christian pastor was played saying the other nations will come in the same gate Abraham comes through, because Abraham was not an Israelite. They try to get slicker and slicker. Abraham was not one of the 12, but he was the father of the 12. Christ said “many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.” So let's find out who's coming from the east and west.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country; And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people.” My people. So that's only the Israelites.

The chapter opens with who it is for: “I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy.” Zion is not all nations on the planet. The ones coming from the east country and the west country to sit down with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are Zion.

And the mere fact that he has to address it proves our teaching is in his school, his church. He is trying to do a cleanup; it is impacting the church.

precepts.text: Deacon: they always like to go to Abraham like that is going to get the other nations in. Paul had to clean it up: neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called. The calling is on Isaac: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, 12 tribes. That cuts his stuff about bringing up Abraham. You just close your Bible up and sit down.
precepts.point: Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven. So let's find out who's coming from the east and west.
precepts.why:
They always like to go to Abraham, like that is going to get the other nations in. The pastor said the nations come in through Abraham's gate because Abraham was not an Israelite and we have the faith of Abraham. Paul had to clean that up.

“Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.” Being of Abraham does not make you one of the children. The calling is on Isaac: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, 12 tribes. That is why Christ said the many from the east and west “shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob”, the fathers of one line.

That cuts his stuff about bringing up Abraham. You just close your Bible up and sit down.

precepts.text: The devils cried out, Art thou come hither to torment us before the time? The demons recognized Christ, and they knew there is a time appointed of torment. So do not let any camp make you think you are going to escape judgment: there is a place appointed where evil spirits and evil people go to suffer torment. Some Israelite camps do counter classes saying there is no hell every time we teach it; they have no scripture to paint that picture.
precepts.point: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch: this is the future of the pride of America.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

precepts.why:
Isaiah says of the king of Babylon, “Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth”. Babylon is the United States of America, and hell is the destiny of its prideful rulers. Hell is a condition, and it is also a real place of torment and suffering. People say, you have nothing, you just walk around in purple clothes talking about the Bible. We know something you don't know: your ass is going to hell. Hell is a real place, and you're going there. We would not trade places with them for all the tea in China, for all the gold in Fort Knox.

Some Israelite camps teach there is no place of torment, and every time we teach about hell they make counter videos. So look at what the devils said to Christ. In the country of the Gergesenes “there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.” “And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?”

The demons recognized Christ, and they knew there is a time appointed for torment. Then “the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.” An evil spirit needs a vessel to inhabit. “And he said unto them, Go.” The whole herd “ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.” The Lord has a place where evil spirits go to suffer torment.

There is a time appointed when everybody who is evil, Israelite or not, is going to pay. Do not let any camp make you think you will escape judgment; they have no scripture to paint that picture.

Why would God make such a place? Because there are people on this earth who do not care about death, prison or you; they will do the most depraved things and laugh about it on the way to the grave. There has to be an extreme punishment for people who disregard life. If there were no hell and no place of suffering, God would not be feared. So there is a hell, God has it prepared, and the wicked, including wicked Israelites, are going into it.

precepts.text: Many shall come from the east and west and sit down with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, but the children of the kingdom, the wicked elders, shall be cast into outer darkness.
precepts.point: In Luke 20:16 they answered, God forbid: they would not give up their place.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

precepts.why:
In the parable the husbandmen beat, killed and stoned the servants, the prophets, and then killed the son to seize his inheritance. Christ tells them who it is about: “The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.” The builders who rejected the stone are the elders. When he told the same parable in Luke, they said “God forbid”: they would kill Christ before they lost their place as the heirs and rulers.

Matthew 8 shows the same thing. “Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.” Those are the other husbandmen the vineyard is let out to, the people Ezra spoke of: “Your houses will I give to a people that shall come; which not having heard of me yet shall believe me”. That is us today.

“But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness”. The children of the kingdom are the builders, the wicked elders. It is written in numerous places that the sun shall go down upon them. “There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth”: they are going to die terrible deaths. And they are back again today.

So the kingdom is taken from the wicked rulers who killed the son, and given to those gathered from the east and the west who sit down with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

precepts.text: Show thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded.
precepts.point: The gifts under the tree are offerings at the heathen altar.
precepts.why:
The heathen offered their sacrifices under every green tree and under every thick oak, where they offered sweet savour to their idols. Matthew 5 shows what a sacrifice is called: “if thou bring thy gift to the altar”, and “Leave there thy gift before the altar”, and “then come and offer thy gift”. The gift is the sacrifice.

Matthew 8 proves it again. Christ healed the leper and told him: “See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.” Moses commanded a gift, a sacrifice. The offering at the altar is called a gift.

So when the heathen sacrifice under a tree, they put gifts under the tree. You do not put gifts on top of the tree, beside the tree, or hang them on the tree. You put them under the tree. Where did you learn that from? The gifts under the Christmas tree are offerings at the heathen altar.

Isaiah 57 shows what else was under the tree: “Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children”. Those children were gifts too, slain under the tree. That is why they use the children to allure us in all the most popular holidays, Halloween and Christmas.

Number one, those other nations will come in the same gate that Abraham comes through, because Abraham was not an Israelite. He had faith in God and it was accounted unto him as righteousness, and because we are of faith, we have the faith of Abraham according to Romans chapter 4. Here's my second response: what gate do you have to go through in order to get to these 12 gates? Jesus said, I am the door. I'll tell you, they try to get slicker and slicker. Abraham was not one of the 12, but he was the father of the 12.
Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven. So let's find out who's coming from the east and west.

But what's that prove? That our teachings is in his school, his church. He's trying to do a cleanup. The mere fact that he has to address it is impacting the church. I'm telling y'all right now, it's impacting it.

They brought unto him many that were possessed with devils, and he cast out the spirits with his word and healed all that were sick. Our people today are possessed with legions, and the word of God is what heals here. A sister who says she cannot find a lord so she will go to the world is the same woman she was; sincerely take it to the Lord and look within instead of without. If nothing were wrong with you, why do those thoughts pop up?

Two possessed men came out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass that way. Some people are always in conflict and never at peace; prefer peace, let a car go for less than it is worth rather than keep the drama, and humble yourself with your wife when you see the spirit on her. Call a brother when you are afflicted at home instead of listening to thoughts of suicide, which Satan uses to play on emotions.

The devils asked to go into the herd of swine, and the herd ran violently down into the sea. The demons did not die with the swine; they look for other bodies to jump into. That is why correction is grievous to some brothers and why some complain all day with no solution: if the bathroom is dirty, clean it; pick up a broom. Fast and pray and your own demon will show itself.
